faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Samagra Shiksha Jajpur Part time Teacher (Sanskrit) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form for the Samagra Shiksha Jajpur Part time Teacher (Sanskrit) Recruitment 2026 is 06 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Part time Teacher (Sanskrit) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.A degree with Sanskrit or Sahityacharya to be eligible for the Part time Teacher (Sanskrit) position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit for candidates applying for this recruitment is a minimum of 18 years and a maximum of 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Part time Teacher (Sanskrit) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 8250 for the Part time Teacher (Sanskrit) position.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Part time Teacher (Sanskrit) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Part time Teacher (Sanskrit) post in Samagra Shiksha Jajpur.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Part time Teacher (Sanskrit) role?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on merit, determined by the marks obtained in the qualifying examination.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of Samagra Shiksha Jajpur, which is jajpur.odisha.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be attached with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant certificates with the application form.
